additional_info.subject: RE: AW: ID0370359-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / P1 170000141] Outlets out of order CRM:00643000823
additional_info.body:
Hi Ramona,
I hope this email finds you well.
Regarding the ticket, we have confirmed that the charger configuration is set to a 300kW power rating with High Flex. After making the necessary changes to the PLC configuration, we analyzed the logs and discovered that a total of 8 converters are not powered on. We suggest troubleshooting the following steps:
Please check the fast-down wiring on the converters that are not able to perform the fast shutdown (PowerConverter[0] to PowerConverter[7]).
Verify the 12VDC power supply wiring on the XD5 terminal that connects to the fast shutdown logic.
Inspect the connectors and wiring for any loose connections, as shown in the attached snapshot.
Kindly inform us one day in advance if you plan to perform these troubleshooting steps so we can coordinate with site support. We can also arrange for experts to assist if needed.

Hi Sascha,
Regarding the converter grouping for DC3 and DC4, which involves connectors, FA10, FA11(SPD's), and KF13, I recommend keeping spares of FA10 or FA11, and KF13. If these components are not damaged and the issue is simply due to loose connections, they can be used in future projects where site intervention may be needed.
Thank you for considering this recommendation.
